projects.title: BTC Machine-Learning Research — Results and Validation Lessons
projects.summary: Published results and methodology lessons from a private research project on BTC/USDT (1-minute data with 5-minute, 15-minute and 4-hour context). Documents what held up out of sample (move-size predictability) and what did not (1-minute direction after fees), and how leakage, drift and selection-bias problems were found and fixed. The project code and data are private; only results are public. Not investment advice.
methods: CNNs on image-style encodings of indicator windows
key_results: Bollinger band width vs. next large move: correlation 0.626; high vs. low regime 1.88x vs. 0.44x subsequent move size
Direction at 1 minute not tradeable: 56% win rate but +0.02% average return vs. 0.04% round-trip fee; 0 of 10 indicator combinations held out of sample
Fake 71% direction accuracy traced to future-bar leakage and fixed with causal features and train-only scaling
Chronological hold-out F0.5 0.612 vs. optimistic out-of-fold 0.752
use_cases: Reference for leakage-audit and out-of-sample validation practice in financial ML
Evidence base for the custom model development consulting service
projects.limitations: Single asset; research stage; no net-of-fee profitable strategy is claimed; code private

projects.title: SaMD Regulatory & QARA Playbook for Product Managers
projects.status: active (content verified against official sources in September 2026)
projects.summary: A practical guide, and a working agent toolkit, for product managers building Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and AI-enabled diagnostic imaging products, written from the product side of the table rather than the regulatory-affairs side. The guides explain what EU MDR, FDA premarket review, ISO 13485, the EU AI Act and a QARA function expect from product management. The agents turn a device description into a verified regulatory plan.

guides: FDA premarket pathways (510(k), De Novo, PMA)
SaMD and AI in diagnostic imaging

architecture.agents: Intake, classification, research, documentation, requirements, document check, agile planner and follow-up agents run in a fixed pipeline
architecture.outputs: Classification with a citable rule trace (EU, U.S., IMDRF, IEC 62304, AI Act), applicable laws and guidance, required documents with issuing bodies and order, new-application or renewal check, agile plan with owners and RAID log, email drafts and calendar file
architecture.hallucination_control: The model only reads and extracts. Classification, applicability, sequencing and scheduling are deterministic rules over a curated, versioned knowledge base. Every extracted answer must carry a verbatim quote found in the source; unknown inputs become open questions, never guesses.

projects.license: Guides, templates and knowledge base CC BY 4.0; source code MIT
projects.disclaimer: Educational and planning-support material. It is not legal, regulatory or clinical advice, the agents' outputs are not regulatory determinations, and the software is not a medical device.
use_cases: Product managers and owners working on SaMD or medical imaging software
Engineers and clinical specialists moving into product roles in regulated environments
R&D, QARA and clinical teams that want a shared vocabulary with product management

projects.title: SFDA Regulatory Compliance Agent
projects.summary: AI pre-check agent for Saudi FDA (SFDA) medical device submissions. Scans a submission package against a regulatory corpus and flags missing documents, format issues and regulatory-language gaps before submission. LLM does not pick agents: a YAML-driven state machine controls the flow.

architecture.layers: 4-layer: document ingest and standardization, fixed vector layer with hybrid retrieval, deterministic agent graph, UI with hash-chained Excel audit log

projects.disclaimer: Demonstration and testing only. The regulatory corpus is synthetic and the sample submission is fictional. Output is not legal or regulatory advice.

projects.title: EDE Regulatory Compliance Agent
projects.summary: AI pre-check agent for UAE Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) medical device submissions. Sister project of the SFDA agent with the same deterministic 4-layer architecture: GHTF MD/IVD classification, multi-emirate checklists and an audit trail.
projects.disclaimer: Demonstration and testing only. The regulatory corpus is synthetic and the sample submission is fictional. Output is not legal or regulatory advice.

projects.title: UAE Business Setup Advisor
projects.summary: Evidence-backed advisor for setting up and renewing a business in the UAE (mainland, free zones, multinationals). Every claim is bound to a source record with a SHA-256 hash; the language model never writes answers, and when no verified record covers a case the system abstains and logs it to an escalation queue.

architecture.verification: Three stages: schema check, source exists and hash matches, source is in force today
architecture.answering: Deterministic classification and template-based answers; optional LLM only chooses from fixed vocabularies
architecture.state_machine: Explicit allowed-transition matrix for every step

projects.disclaimer: Demonstration and testing only. Records are sample data not verified against official sources. Output is not legal, tax or regulatory advice.

projects.title: MENA AI Compliance Advisor
projects.summary: Source-grounded compliance support for companies adopting AI in the Middle East, starting with the UAE and Saudi Arabia, with EU rules for cross-border work. Answers questions from official texts (labour law, PDPL, AI ethics principles, EU AI Act, GDPR), tracks cases and documents in Excel, and offers staff training modules. Every finding must quote the official text or it is dropped.

architecture.verification: Deterministic verifier drops any finding whose quote is not in the cited passage
architecture.dissent: A separate challenger agent argues against each draft; disputed findings are shown as unresolved
architecture.human_in_the_loop: A case cannot be approved without a named human reviewer

projects.disclaimer: Informational examples only; not legal advice. Indexed texts may be outdated or unofficial translations.
